description: Issue17 questions kept separate from frozen retrieval sets

questions.query: What mass precision and coherent delay state budget does G-P recommend, and does it authorize production migration?
facts: G-P is an experimental state-budget decision only; production Cell layout and Water migration require separate authority.
Issue18 still needs a concrete motion target; Issue19 is independent, Issue20 blocked and G-final open.

questions.query: How does the Water precision experiment separate initial quantization, runtime conservation and normalized versus literal thresholds?
facts: Use each arm's exact integer lattice for conservation, separately report initial normalized error.
P1 uses normalized film and tolerance; P2 fixes normalized film and compares tolerance against literal one unit.

questions.query: Does fewer Water mass bits save cell bandwidth or does apparent speed come from active work and early stalling?
facts: All arms use the same eight-byte carrier; there is no byte bandwidth saving.
Total active work and ns per visited cell are separate; early stalls and film or front losses qualify performance.
